- memory_id "1000169": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a notifier consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000221": The ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: ledger service, the cache change)

- memory_id "1000296" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000033": The ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000161" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service, Postgres 14)
- memory_id "1000281": Team Dune observed that the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: team Dune, the cache change, notification service)
- memory_id "1000107" [constraint]: The ledger service only ships on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000145": The reporting service depends on the ledger service for the nightly balance export.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000248": The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000171" [decision]: Notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000087": The billing API depends on the ledger service for invoice postings.  (about: ledger service, billing API)
- memory_id "1000150": Oskar runs the weekly architecture review.  (about: Oskar, weekly architecture review)
- memory_id "1000314": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, the client rollout)
- memory_id "1000373": The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: authentication gateway, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000332" [decision]: The product catalog will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: product catalog, image metadata)
- memory_id "1000381": As of 2025-05-13, Priya Raman holds the Atlas team pager instead of Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000346" [constraint]: The indexer is pinned to OpenSearch 2.11, and the pin lifts when the full reindex completes.  (about: indexer, OpenSearch 2.11, the full reindex)
